title: The Majorana Clifford algebra underlies all fermions

statements.text: The combination of the simplest Clifford algebra of iterants with a commuting copy of itself is the underlying structure of Majorana fermions and of all fermions, and it gives the Majorana Dirac equation in split quaternions.

sources.quote: This combination of the simplest Clifford algebra with itself is the underlying structure of Majorana Fermions, forming indeed the underlying structure of all Fermions
